key_insight: LongMemEval-V2 provides a targeted benchmark that measures whether agent memory systems truly internalize environment-specific, long-term experience (interface affordances, workflows, recurring failures) rather than just short user traces or downstream task performance.
problem_solved: Existing agent memory benchmarks focus on user histories, short traces, or end-task success and do not directly evaluate whether agents accumulate and apply environment-specific experience over long horizons. LME-V2 fills this gap by creating tasks and probes that test retention, recall, and adaptation to recurring web-environment dynamics.
method: Curate realistic, specialized web-style environments and recurring episodes that require remembering interface affordances, state dynamics, and prior failure modes.
Design targeted memory probes and quantitative metrics (e.g., retention, precision of recall, adaptation to recurring failures) to evaluate internalized experience independently of end-task reward.
Provide an evaluation protocol and baseline model runs to quantify how well different memory systems retain and apply long-term environment knowledge.
impact: LME-V2 gives practitioners a practical diagnostic to benchmark and improve agent memory architectures, enabling development of agents that behave as experienced, reliable collaborators in specialized web environments. This leads to more robust long-term performance and faster adaptation to recurring issues.
visual_elements: Timeline chart showing interaction episodes and measured memory strength (retention decay vs. rehearsal/adaptation events).
Schematic of a web-style environment annotated with affordances, state changes, and recurring failure modes that the agent must remember.
Comparison bar/heatmap of models on key metrics (retention, recall accuracy, failure-aware adaptation) to highlight trade-offs.

paper_title: LongMemEval-V2: Evaluating Long-Term Agent Memory Toward Experienced Colleagues
paper_authors: Di Wu, Zixiang Ji, Asmi Kawatkar, Bryan Kwan, Jia-Chen Gu
